**Reading.** The overhead is the quality-path rewriter's cost per prompt, 6% of a `gpt-4o`
prompt at the configured prices (`terser.phase3.build_features.quality_overhead_pct`:
rewriter input + output price over the target's input price). The best threshold is still
"rewrite everything" (-inf): predicted achievable savings are far above 6% for almost every
prompt (mean net saving 32.6% at full rewrite), so no threshold skips enough low-savings prompts
to pay for the savings it gives up. The rule matters for cheap targets: at the self-hosted
`qwen2.5` price the same overhead is 75%, and most prompts would be skipped.
